svg.data-weight-note: 19.4 lb (8.8 kg) with one power supply (Table 6)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE or 1 GbE on each fixed SFP+ port
svg.data-expansion-ports: up to 48 10 GbE ports with two 8-port modules, or 2 x 40 GbE with a QSFP+ module
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 120 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 7.8 A and 3.8 A
svg.data-power-input-dc: operating range -36 to -72 VDC, nominal -48 VDC, 7 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load sharing; do not mix AC and DC, or AFI and AFO
svg.data-fans: three fan modules and a fan in each supply; the switch runs 30 seconds while one fan module is replaced
svg.data-heat-btu-h: 1146 BTU an hour at the maximum system power (Table 22)
svg.data-altitude: no loss of performance to 10,000 ft (3,048 m)
svg.data-software: Junos OS, first release 12.2R1 for the 32F and 12.3R5 for the -S
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches, mixed with EX4200 and EX4500
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ and 1 GbE SFP in any port, in any combination
svg.data-expansion: two module slots (front and rear), EX4550-EM-8XSFP, EX4550-EM-8XT, EX4550-EM-2QSFP and EX4550-VC-128G
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
svg.data-console: mini-USB console port (active) and RJ-45 console port (passive)
